summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement (No. 2) amending its registration for a pre-paid purchase facility with Mapie Wind Limited, a BVI exempted company, under an August 7, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement. Up to $36 million in pre-paid purchases may be drawn over two years, with shares priced at 50% of the specified closing price, subject to a $0.10 floor as reset by Amendment No. 1 on November 6, 2026, following 1-for-20 and 1-for-8 consolidations. November 12, 2026 filing. Watch dilution and pricing overhang.
